title: TSRP Update
summary: A full rework of the stock market -- fixed share supply, daily price movement, and real company events with reasons you can actually read.

sections.heading: Fixed Share Supply
items: Every company now has a set number of shares. Buying and selling no longer moves the price at all -- it only moves shares between the available pool and your portfolio.
Once every share is owned, nobody can buy more until someone sells or the company issues additional shares.
Selling always returns your shares to the available pool for someone else to buy.

sections.heading: New: Daily Price Movement
items: Prices now move once a day instead of drifting randomly every few minutes. Each stock gets a direction (up or down) and a size (small, medium, or large), all with configurable odds.
On top of that, stocks have a separate chance of a company event, positive or negative, minor or major, each with its own price impact.
This means a stock can trend upward for weeks and still take an occasional hit, or a struggling company can suddenly bounce back on good news.

sections.heading: New: Company Events With Real Reasons
items: Every event now comes with an actual reason, like a company signing a government contract, launching a new product, or getting hit with a lawsuit.
Use /stock events on any ticker to see its recent events and exactly why the price moved.
These are entirely fictional and generated by the economy, not tied to anything real.

sections.heading: New: Share Issuance
items: Companies can now issue additional shares as a real, logged event with its own price impact, instead of the share count just being edited freely.
This is the only way a company's total share count grows outside of a stock split, and it opens up buying into companies that were previously fully owned.

sections.heading: More Stock Stats
items: /stock info and the stock pages on the site now show 24-hour, 7-day, and 30-day change, all-time high and low, total shares, available shares, and market value.

Business-backed stocks (companies players have taken public) now settle trades against that company's own treasury instead of a shared pool, so buying into one is a more direct investment in that specific business.

title: TSRP Update
summary: A new Fast Pass command for staff transfers, and an updated onboarding DM for new staff.

sections.heading: New: /fastpass
items: Fast-tracks a Fast Pass / Staff Transfer Summer Programme applicant straight to Junior Moderator with a single command. Just pick the player, no trainer notes or co-trainers needed.
Doesn't require the Awaiting Training role, since a Fast Pass applicant applies via ticket instead of going through the normal trainee pipeline.
Same role assignment, nickname sync, and staff announcements as /passtraining.

sections.heading: Updated: /passtraining Onboarding DM
items: New staff are now told they must join the TSRP Roblox group, with the link included.
The Staff Panel link now points straight to the login page.

title: TSRP Update
summary: A full economy rebalance -- /work pays enough to actually afford storefront items now, and several more rates can be tuned by staff without a code change.

sections.heading: Economy Rebalance
items: /work payouts are up roughly 2.5x across every job tier, and the daily bonus went from $50 to $75, so a shift or two now actually covers a storefront purchase.
Investment/stock dividend rate, property resale rate, bank loan term limits, and the minimum loan interest rate can now be adjusted by staff instead of requiring a code change.

title: TSRP Update
summary: Banks are now entirely player-run, players can own more than one business, personal insurance is here, and picking a bank or insurer is now as easy as typing its name.

sections.heading: Player-Owned Banks, Fully
items: Robbing a bank or ATM with /crime now always targets a real, player-owned bank -- the old generic, unowned bank is gone for good.

Banks now have several ways to actually make money instead of just loan interest: account maintenance fees, withdrawal fees, a loan origination fee, a late payment fee on overdue loans, and a small daily return on their own idle treasury.
All of these fees are tunable by Super Admin, so the economy can be rebalanced without a code change.

sections.heading: New: Own Multiple Businesses
items: Players are no longer limited to one business -- own several at once, each with its own balance, employees, revenue, loans, insurance, and reputation.
Super Admin can still set a cap on how many businesses one player is allowed to own.

sections.heading: New: Personal Insurance
items: Players can now buy their own insurance policies -- theft, crime, gambling, and general financial protection -- and file a claim if they suffer a covered loss.
Every claim is manually reviewed before it pays out, and payouts come from the insurer's own balance, never out of thin air.
Gambling coverage specifically comes with strict limits so insurance can't be used to guarantee casino winnings.
Staff can review every policy, claim, and insurance company from a new Insurance tab in Super Admin.

sections.heading: Easier Bank & Insurance Selection
items: Choosing a bank to rob, register with, or apply for a loan from -- or an insurance company to buy a policy from -- is now a simple type-to-search list of business names, instead of picking a player first.

sections.heading: Other Fixes
items: VIPs can now post links and gifs in any channel (invite links are still always blocked).

title: TSRP Update
summary: Ticket transcripts now look like real conversations, duty status gets watched automatically, and a big pass on cleaning up how Discord accounts are shown across the site.

sections.heading: Ticket Transcripts, Rebuilt
items: Transcripts now render like an actual Discord conversation -- real avatars next to each message instead of a flat text export.
Mentions are readable again: @user, @role (with the role's real color), and #channel all show their actual name instead of raw code, and still work correctly on old transcripts.
Added Copy Transcript and Download Transcript buttons for grabbing a plain-text copy of the whole conversation.

sections.heading: New: Duty Status Monitoring
items: The system now automatically flags a staff member's shift if they're marked On Duty but aren't actually in the server, or if the server is Shutdown while they're clocked in.
Flags never end a shift automatically -- they just alert management and show a warning badge on the panel so it can be reviewed by a person.

sections.heading: Cleaner Discord Account Display
items: Discord IDs no longer show up as the main thing you see anywhere in the panel -- names and usernames are front and center, with the ID only surfacing where you're actually searching for someone.
Every account search box across the panel (Economy Control, ownership transfers, etc.) now uses the same real search-and-pick tool instead of requiring a raw Discord ID.

sections.heading: /players Redesign
items: Cleaner, less cluttered layout for the server's live player roster.
New "View Staff In-Game" button shows exactly which staff are currently in the server, their rank, and their live duty status.

sections.heading: Other Fixes
items: Fixed several places where a message would ping someone twice, or ping when it shouldn't have.
Fixed rank/duty tags (like "ChM |") sometimes leaking into places they shouldn't, like the public leaderboard.
Fixed a bug where a Discord lookup hiccup could get someone stuck showing as "Player #1234" for several minutes.
Added a proper 404 page instead of a blank screen on a bad link.
Removed the shift type field from Start Shift -- one less thing to fill in.

title: TSRP Update
summary: A real debt system, smarter payments, and a faster /work.

sections.heading: New: Loans & Debt
items: Borrow with /loan across four types -- Personal, Business, Emergency, and High-Risk -- each with its own rate, limit, and repayment term.
Financial reputation now tracks your repayment history: pay early or on time and future loans get cheaper and bigger; default and they get worse. Check it anytime with /loan status.

sections.heading: Smarter Payments
items: If you don't have enough cash for something, the bot now automatically covers the rest from your bank savings instead of just failing.
Mandatory costs (fines, taxes, upkeep) always go through in full, even if it means going into debt -- no more dodging a penalty by keeping your cash low.

sections.heading: Faster /work
items: The cooldown on /work is down to 30 minutes (from 2 hours) while we tune the economy.

title: TSRP Update
summary: Two brand new ways to make (or lose) money -- Poker and Crime -- plus easier navigation across the site.

sections.heading: New: Poker
items: Challenge another player to a hand of heads-up Texas Hold'em with /poker -- they can accept or decline before anything's on the line.
Full betting rounds (check, call, bet, raise, all-in, fold), private hole cards, and automatic hand evaluation and payout at showdown.

sections.heading: New: Crime System
items: Rob a bank, an ATM, or a store with /crime for a chance at a quick payout -- higher reward comes with higher risk and a longer cooldown.
Pickpocket another player for a small amount of cash. Every attempt has a chance of getting caught and fined.

sections.heading: Easier Navigation
items: Added a trail of links (e.g. Economy / Stock Market / TSRP) to pages that were more than one click from the main menu, so you're never stuck using the browser's back button.

title: TSRP Update
summary: The whole site now updates live as things happen, plus a real online/offline status, market events, smarter economy news, and a batch of visual fixes.

sections.heading: The Site Feels Live Now
items: Player count, server status, stock prices, and activity feeds refresh every few seconds without reloading the page.
Economy stats, leaderboards, staff roster, and the stock/economy admin panels refresh automatically too, just less often since they change less often.
Changes made anywhere -- the bot, the staff panel, or the public site -- now show up everywhere else on their own.

sections.heading: Accurate Online/Offline Status
items: The site's Online/Offline badge now reflects the actual /startup and /shutdown status set by staff, instead of guessing from server activity.
Fixes the badge previously showing "Online" with 0 players, 0 in queue, and 0 staff on duty.

sections.heading: Stock Price Charts
items: Charts now default to a 5-hour window and can be expanded to 1 day, 3 days, 7 days, or 1 month.
Short ranges now show the time of day on the chart, not just the date.

sections.heading: Market Events
items: The market can now go through real events -- crashes, booms, and sector-specific shocks that move stock prices.
Events can hit specific tickers, a whole category, or the entire market at once.

sections.heading: Smarter Economy News
items: Economy news now has importance levels (notable vs. major), so bigger stories stand out from routine updates.
New stock listings, large trades, market freezes, and lottery wins now show up in the news automatically.

sections.heading: Site Fixes
items: Fixed the mobile menu button being invisible (and causing a sliver of horizontal scroll) on small screens.
The browser tab now shows "Texas State RP" with the TSRP logo instead of the generic staff panel title and placeholder icon.
Updated the homepage intro to be brand-specific instead of generic ER:LC boilerplate.

title: TSRP Update
summary: Routine economy actions are now public, lottery winners get a heads-up DM, and there's a new channel for economy news.

sections.heading: Public Economy Actions
items: Buying/selling stocks, storefront purchases and listings, bank deposits/withdrawals, shop purchases, market listings, casino game toggles, quitting a job, investment trades, property buy/sell, and loan repayments now show up publicly in the channel instead of only to the person who ran the command.
Error messages, cooldown notices, and personal info (portfolios, watchlists, private business earnings, contract negotiations) still stay private.

sections.heading: Lottery Winner Notifications
items: Winning the lottery now sends you a DM with your prize amount, which lottery you won, and your updated balance.
If your DMs are off, the lottery draw still completes normally -- you just won't get the DM.

sections.heading: Economy Announcements Channel
items: A new channel now posts live news for the economy: major stock price swings, dividend payouts, and new businesses opening.
Keeps everyone in the loop on what's happening with the market and the economy without having to watch it manually.

title: TSRP Update
summary: AutoMod offenses now fade over time instead of piling up forever, and HR staff can manage them directly.

sections.heading: Fairer AutoMod
items: AutoMod offenses now expire automatically after a set time, so something from weeks ago won't push you into a harsher punishment today.
If you're kicked, banned, or manually cleared by HR, your AutoMod offense record resets.
If enough old offenses expire, the next punishment level automatically eases back up instead of staying maxed out.

sections.heading: HR Panel
items: HR staff can now look up any member's AutoMod offenses, see their full history, and clear offenses when appropriate.

title: TSRP Update
summary: Tickets now close automatically when the person who opened them leaves the server.

sections.heading: Ticket Cleanup
items: If someone leaves the server while they still have an open ticket, it's now automatically closed for them.
The closure works exactly like a normal ticket close -- a full transcript is saved and the usual logs are posted, with the reason recorded as "User left the server."

title: TSRP Update
summary: Fixed a bug that could cause startup announcements and info panels to post multiple times instead of once.

sections.heading: Bug Fix: Duplicate Announcements & Panels
items: Fixed a bug where running /startup could post the online announcement, and ping @everyone, more than once instead of exactly once.
Fixed persistent info panels (like Guidelines, Booster Perks, and the Department Hub) sometimes posting a brand new duplicate message instead of updating the existing one.
Both issues came from the same underlying cause, which is now fixed at the source rather than papered over.

title: TSRP Update
summary: A brand new stock market, plus storefronts and a server-wide lottery -- new ways to earn, invest, and spend your money.

sections.heading: New: Stock Market
items: Added a full stock market to the economy -- buy and sell shares of different companies, right from Discord.
Every stock has its own price, description, industry, and history -- check daily, weekly, and monthly performance before you buy.
Prices move on their own over time, and your own buying and selling nudges the price too -- it's a living market, not a fixed price list.
Keep a watchlist of stocks you're interested in, and get a DM when one of them makes a big move.
Some stocks pay out dividends automatically to anyone holding shares.
Track your full portfolio -- how much each stock is worth, your average cost, and both your realized and unrealized profit or loss.
Keep an eye on Market News for company announcements and bigger economic events that move prices.

sections.heading: New: Storefronts
items: Player-owned businesses can now be Storefronts instead of a plain business with no purpose of its own.
Storefront owners can stock items with their own prices and quantities, and sell directly to other players -- earnings go straight into the business's treasury.
Owners can check their storefront's sales and revenue at any time.

sections.heading: New: Lottery
items: Added a server-wide lottery -- buy tickets for a chance to win the entire pot.
The more tickets you buy, the better your odds when a winner is drawn.

title: TSRP Update
summary: A full redesign of the staff panel to make everyday tasks faster and clearer, plus a new way to manually link Roblox accounts for players Bloxlink can't verify.

sections.heading: New: Manual Account Verification
items: Added a new Account Verification page (Management and above) for linking a Discord member's Roblox account by hand, for the rare cases where Bloxlink can't verify someone.

Search for any member, then link their Roblox account by typing their username -- it looks up the real account and shows their avatar, display name, account age, and verification badge before you confirm.

The system checks for conflicts automatically -- if that Roblox account is already linked to someone else, or the member already has a different account linked, you'll get a warning before anything changes.
Linking or changing an account updates the member's server nickname and verified role automatically, so everything stays in sync.
Every link, change, and unlink is saved to a history log showing what changed, who did it, when, and why.

sections.heading: Dashboard
items: Redesigned the Dashboard with a cleaner layout and quicker access to common actions.
Added a shift leaderboard you can open right from the Dashboard.

sections.heading: HR Panel
items: Reorganized the HR Panel so related tools are grouped together and easier to find.
Fixed a layout bug where the LOA History card could overflow past the edge of the page on certain screen sizes.

sections.heading: Internal Affairs
items: Simplified the Internal Affairs page so issuing strikes and suggesting promotions or demotions takes fewer steps.

sections.heading: Super Admin
items: Reorganized the Super Admin page into clear tabs instead of one long scrolling page.

sections.heading: Login
items: Refreshed the login page with a cleaner, more polished look.

sections.heading: General
items: Improved spacing, sizing, and alignment across the panel so pages feel more consistent from one to the next.
The panel now works better on tablets and phones across the redesigned pages.

title: TSRP Update
summary: A new Changelog page for the staff panel, plus a full redesign of its navigation.

sections.heading: New Changelog Page
items: Added a Changelog page to the staff panel, right from the sidebar -- browse every past update and click into the full details.
From now on, every update posts here on the site and in this channel at the same time.

sections.heading: Staff Panel Refresh
items: Completely redesigned the sidebar navigation with a cleaner look and smoother animations.
Added a proper profile section at the bottom showing your avatar, name, and rank.
Fixed the sidebar being cut off and hard to use on phones -- it now slides open like a proper menu instead.
Fixed some pages not being centered correctly on wider screens.
The panel now uses the real Texas State RP logo instead of a placeholder.

title: TSRP Update
summary: A major update covering moderation, the Department Hub, staff onboarding, and a brand new player economy.

sections.heading: Keeping the Server Safe
items: The bot now automatically catches and handles raids (a flood of new members joining at once) and message spam, without staff needing to step in.

Added a Ban Review queue in Discord for Internal Affairs and above -- staff can review a submitted ban request and accept, decline, or skip it right from Discord, and accepting it bans the player immediately.
Tightened up who's allowed to use tickets and issue strikes.

sections.heading: Department Hub & Staff Info
items: Fixed the Department Hub showing old, outdated info after it had already been updated.
Refreshed the Staff Handbook and added a new Staff Info section with a striking system reference.
Removed the "Cuff Rushing" rule.

sections.heading: A Whole New Economy
items: Banking -- deposit, withdraw, and earn daily interest on your savings.
Taxes -- personal and business taxes now apply automatically.
Loans -- borrow money with a credit limit based on how active you are, and pay it back over time.
Investments -- buy into someone else's business and earn a share of its profits.
Property -- buy houses, apartments, mansions, and vehicles, each with its own upkeep cost.
Items -- buy collectible items from the shop.
Marketplace -- buy and sell items directly with other players.
Contracts -- create a formal IOU with another player that tracks what they owe until it's paid off.
Typing out an exact business, property, or listing name is no longer required -- everything now suggests matches as you type.

sections.heading: Fixes & Improvements
items: Fixed department playtime counting time when the server or bot was actually down.
Fixed ban submissions sometimes showing "user ID unknown."
Off-duty warnings no longer trigger from harmless commands.
Sending a message to multiple people at once now actually reaches everyone, not just the first person.
Leaderboards and other list-style messages no longer ping everyone shown in them.
Added an Unban option to punishment logs.
Fixed the staff panel showing a 404 error on refresh.

title: TSRP Staff System
summary: The bot and the staff panel are now fully connected. Anything you do in one shows up in the other instantly, so there's no more guessing if something actually went through.

sections.heading: Logging In
items: You log into the panel with your Discord account. Your permissions are pulled straight from your current rank, so there's nothing to set up manually.

sections.heading: Dashboard
items: Start/pause/end your shift with a live timer
See who's currently on duty and who's on break
Shift leaderboard and your full personal shift history
Live, searchable in-game player list
Log punishments (Warning, Kick, Ban, Temp Ban, BOLO, Note) with username autofill
Live activity feed (joins, leaves, kills, commands, mod/emergency calls)

sections.heading: HR Panel (Management+)
items: Run in-game commands
Issue/remove strikes, with a live strike board (3 strikes triggers auto action)
Instant promote/demote
Review pending rank change requests
Terminate staff
Process resignations (Director only)
Manage LOAs (approve, extend, end early, view history)

sections.heading: IA Panel (IA+)
items: Request backup on duty
Issue strikes on anyone regardless of rank
Suggest rank changes

sections.heading: Bot Commands
items: Everything from the panel also works in Discord: /shift, /loa, /endloa, /strike, /unstrike, /rankChange, /terminate, /resign, /runcommand, /callstaff, /players, /status, /activitycheck, /passtraining, /failtraining, /feedback, /fixnick, /say, /startup, /shutdown, plus full ticket commands (/tclose, /tadd, /tremove, /ttranscript, etc).

sections.heading: Automatic Stuff
items: Nicknames update on their own based on your duty status and rank
Off-duty command use gets flagged
Booster perks granted/removed automatically
Live status card and voice channel stats
Everything logs to one central audit channel
